title: data_aggregation step configuration (architecture section 4)
description: Grain, groups, aggregate expressions, late-arrival policy. Each aggregate declares its own neutral type: an aggregate replaces the field set it groups, so its type cannot be carried over from an input field and the contract derivation (ergasterion/framework/contract.py) fails closed without it. 'type' is shaped loosely here (string or object); the neutral-type system itself is enforced once, in ergasterion/framework/declaration.py.
